title: Deep Dive: Agentic RAG Architectures, Vector Cache Warming & Context Window Budgeting
summary: Explores production caching for vector databases, context window compression techniques, and automated LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation pipelines for high-throughput enterprise systems.
hosts: Host A (Principal AI Engineer) & Host B (LLMOps Lead)

chapters.title: 1. Vector Cache Warming vs Real-Time Hybrid Search

ai.title: Predictive Vector Cache Warming vs Real-Time Hybrid Search Latency
bullets: Two-Tier Caching Architecture: Pairs an in-memory Redis semantic cache (similarity threshold 0.96) with an HNSW graph vector index to deliver sub-10ms response times for common queries.
Scheduled Partition Warming: Pre-loads frequently accessed vector partitions into RAM prior to high-volume query periods, eliminating cold-start disk I/O penalties.
Context Compaction: Semantic chunking and window compression reduce LLM prompt token load by 45% while preserving critical reasoning state.
ai.interview_framing: In GenAI architecture interviews, explain how predictive cache warming mathematically bounds embedding latency and avoids expensive vector database scan penalties under sudden traffic spikes.

cloud.title: Crossplane Infrastructure Orchestration & OIDC Token Federation
bullets: Kubernetes-Native Infrastructure: Replaces fragmented Terraform scripts with declarative Crossplane custom resource definitions (CRDs).
OIDC Cloud Federation: Eliminates permanent IAM credentials across AWS, Azure, and GCP using workload identity federation.
Automated Drift Reconciliation: Continuously reconciles live cloud state every 60 seconds against Git repositories.
cloud.interview_framing: Contrast Crossplane with Terraform, explaining how continuous Kubernetes control loops prevent configuration drift and provide unified governance across AWS and Azure.

data.title: Apache Iceberg Partition Evolution & Z-Order Clustering at Scale
bullets: Hidden Partitioning: Iceberg automatically translates SQL timestamp filters into physical directory paths without requiring users to maintain synthetic date columns.
Z-Order Space-Filling Curves: Colocates multidimensional query attributes within Parquet row groups to skip 80% of file I/O during analytical scans.
Metadata Compaction: Automated background maintenance jobs compact small metadata JSON snapshots into optimized Avro manifests.
data.interview_framing: Explain why Apache Iceberg's metadata tree structure avoids S3 object listing bottlenecks and enables schema evolution without rewriting petabyte-scale data files.

sec.title: SLSA Level 3 Provenance & Cosign Keyless Image Signing in CI/CD
bullets: Keyless Ephemeral Signing: Cosign utilizes Sigstore Fulcio and Rekor transparency logs to sign container images with short-lived OIDC certificates.
SLSA Build Provenance: Generates cryptographic in-toto build attestations verifying source repository, commit SHA, and build environment.
Admission Controller Enforcement: Kyverno and Gatekeeper reject unsigned container images from deploying to production Kubernetes clusters.
sec.interview_framing: Detail how keyless container signing eliminates private key management overhead while guaranteeing cryptographic supply-chain integrity for enterprise deployments.

devops.title: Context Window Compaction & Automated LLM-as-a-Judge Pipelines
bullets: G-Eval Metric Frameworks: Evaluates AI responses against structured rubrics across faithfulness, relevance, and safety prior to canary deployment.
Rolling Context Summarization: Dynamically compresses long multi-turn dialogue histories to stay within the 8,000-token precision sweet spot.
Continuous CI/CD Regression Testing: Automated regression suites run synthetic question sets against candidate models on every Git pull request.
devops.interview_framing: Highlight how automated LLM-as-a-Judge testing in CI/CD gives engineering teams confidence to update system prompts and models without risking silent behavioral regressions.

arch.title: Transactional Outbox Pattern & Debezium CDC for Microservices
bullets: Dual-Write Problem Elimination: Database writes and outbox table entries commit in a single atomic ACID transaction.
Log-Based CDC: Debezium reads database write-ahead logs (WAL) to publish events to Apache Kafka with zero polling overhead.
At-Least-Once Delivery Guarantees: Consumers utilize idempotent message handlers with Redis deduplication keys.
arch.interview_framing: Explain how the Transactional Outbox pattern guarantees event consistency between relational databases and Kafka event streams without distributed two-phase commit locks.

finops.title: Kubernetes Karpenter Autoscaling & Predictive Node Provisioning
bullets: Direct EC2 Fleet Allocation: Karpenter launches customized EC2 instance sizes matching exact pod resource requests in <45 seconds.
Automated Consolidation: Continuously replaces underutilized nodes with smaller spot instances, reducing cluster compute costs by 32%.
Elimination of Static Node Groups: Removes over-provisioned worker pools in favor of dynamic JIT scheduling.
finops.interview_framing: Compare Karpenter with standard Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler, showing how just-in-time instance sizing prevents node fragmentation and cuts cloud spend.

gov.title: Enterprise Privacy-Preserving AI & Synthetic Data Governance
bullets: Differential Privacy Mechanisms: Injects bounded mathematical noise into training datasets to prevent model inversion attacks.
Synthetic Data Generation: Generates statistically representative test datasets for AI evaluation without exposing customer PII.
Data Localization & Encryption: Ensures sensitive data remains processed within compliant regional sovereign cloud boundaries.
gov.interview_framing: Articulate how synthetic data pipelines satisfy enterprise data privacy requirements and enable rapid LLM development without compromising customer privacy.

flashcards.question: What is the primary architectural trade-off between Semantic Caching and Real-Time Vector Similarity Search?
flashcards.answer: Semantic caching achieves sub-5ms query times and saves API cost by matching cosine similarity against cached responses, but risks serving stale answers if underlying source documents update frequently.

Section 1: The Vector Search Latency Bottleneck.
In large-scale agentic RAG pipelines, computing dense vector embeddings and traversing billion-node HNSW graphs on every conversational turn creates 150-300ms latency overheads.

Section 2: The Two-Tier Cache Architecture.
By deploying Redis Semantic Cache in front of the vector database, queries with cosine similarity > 0.96 return pre-computed context chunks in under 4ms, reducing downstream embedding API costs by 42%.
